title: Retry and backoff for 429 and 5xx
spec: Add src/venue/retry.ts exporting withRetry(transport: Transport, policy?: RetryPolicy): Transport. Reads (urls without /say-signed/ or /set-signed/) retry 502/503/504 up to policy.readTries (default 8) with 400ms*2^n jitter capped at 4s. Writes retry 502/503/504 up to policy.writeTries (default 4) with 3s*(n+1). Any 429 waits the Retry-After header (seconds) or 5s, up to policy.tries429 (default 4), EXCEPT a 429 whose body matches /room-creation budget/i, which is returned immediately (the caller falls back to the board). Network errors thrown by the inner transport retry like a 5xx. Sleep through an injectable policy.sleep so tests run instantly. Never retry a 2xx, 4xx other than 429, or 409.
done: The wrapped transport replays the recorded 429/503 sequences to a final 200 with the expected sleeps and returns the room-budget 429 untouched.
